description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWords class, testing methods such as parseCommaSeparated, sanitize, and parseIfChanged.

classes.name: WakeWordsTest
classes.description: A test class for WakeWords utility functions related to wake word processing.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparatedTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that a comma-separated string is correctly parsed into a list, trimming whitespace and removing empty entries.

methods.name: sanitizeTrimsCapsAndFallsBack
methods.description: Tests the sanitize method for trimming, capitalizing, limiting length, and fallback to defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Tests that sanitize correctly limits the number of words to maxWords.

methods.name: parseIfChangedSkipsWhenUnchanged
methods.description: Tests that parseIfChanged returns null when input string matches current list.

methods.name: parseIfChangedReturnsUpdatedList
methods.description: Tests that parseIfChanged returns a new list when input string differs from current list.
